steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations on plans, problems and responsibilities

tasks.design: Retain personal advising, with existing guidance available in {DOCS}. No recurring clerical component is established that would justify moving the advice into an automated service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the organization and situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared guidance remains usable without new software.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing student autonomy, risk and institutional responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Building trust while helping students make their own decisions.
tasks.altitude: The advising week and authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Student organization advising requires contextual interpersonal judgement; no time reduction is established here.

assumptions: Boundary covers advising student organizations, including reading their questions; event execution and institutional approvals remain outside it.
Students supply questions and plans in the existing exchange; no structured risk classification, eligibility flag or free capture process is assumed.
Test native guidance sharing before custom code; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because advice and existing guidance access remain unchanged.
unknowns: Frequency of genuinely repeated procedural questions
research_questions: Is there a repeated factual question component large enough to justify a separately maintained guide?

already_counted.description: Reading plans, advising and agreeing follow-up

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Existing human advice and preparation remain counted; no recurring FAQ workload is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop research aims, methods, budget assumptions and funder requirements
Write grant proposal sections from the agreed research plan

loop.purpose: Draft narrative sections without changing the research commitments
loop.input: Research plan, verified references, budget basis and permitted funding call
loop.output: Draft sections mapped to call requirements and source material
loop.check: Lecturer verifies methods, feasibility, claims, citations and every promised output against the supplied plan
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; absent evidence or unresolved contradictions go to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining the research case requires contextual prose beyond form filling

steps.what: Reconcile grant proposals, verify commitments and approve the final package

tasks.design: Use approved drafting support in {DOCS} to turn a researcher-owned plan into proposal sections. The lecturer retains research design, citations, budget commitments and final package approval before the normal submission process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative sections repeatedly restate a research plan in funder-specific form.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bounded drafting can produce a first narrative for expert revision.
tasks.still_hard: Originality, methodology, ethical feasibility and realistic commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which research is worthwhile and deliverable.
tasks.altitude: A small drafting gain leaves the lecturer responsible for the substantive research case.

reach.learn: Funder criteria and internal approval procedures

evidence.claim: A bounded model draft can help express a supplied research plan, but the saving is unmeasured and depends on revision effort.

assumptions: Boundary starts with the research idea and call and ends at the lecturer-approved proposal package; institutional authorization and portal submission remain outside this task and receive no saving.

Lecturer produces aims, methods, milestones, source references, requested amounts and call limits in s1, including capture time. Missing commitments are resolved manually; the model cannot create them.
Native templates and approved document drafting are tested first. Only applicant-owned material allowed by funder and institutional policy is processed; confidential referee material is excluded.
Research support approval work is unchanged; no free transfer of proposal checking to that role is assumed.
unknowns: Current effort in substantive design versus narrative drafting
research_questions: Does a permitted draft reduce writing effort after every research claim and commitment is checked?

incremental.description: Maintaining call restrictions, templates and failure examples

approvals.approved_version: Final narrative, references, budget, milestones and call version; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross12 minus focal upkeep6 gives net6. Range allows bespoke calls, restricted tools and intensive scientific corrections; research design and final approval retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Provide professional consulting services through evidence review, discussion and tailored recommendations

tasks.design: Keep professional consulting with the lecturer, using {DOCS} for source material. The task does not establish a separate repeated reporting workload with demonstrated removable time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on client context, evidence and professional responsibility.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing evidence access can support the work without a new automation layer.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing conflicting evidence and consequences in the client's setting.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding institutional constraints and explaining defensible recommendations.
tasks.altitude: Consulting responsibility and working time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Translate research into practical policy options
reach.learn: Client decision processes and implementation constraints

evidence.claim: Professional consulting includes contextual analysis and accountable advice; no task-specific labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary includes reviewing the consulting question, discussing context and providing recommendations; procurement and client implementation are separate.
Client supplies source context through the existing exchange; the lecturer reads it within s1. No ready-made structured policy assessment is assumed.
Test native source search and document features before custom code; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new consulting automation or transferred work is introduced.
unknowns: Whether engagements have repeated report sections
research_questions: Can actual consulting time logs establish a separable repetitive preparation component?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Context review and professional advice remain fully counted; generic drafting capability alone establishes no consulting saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains advisory and research authority with limited grant drafting support.
reach: Coordinate proposal requirements with research support
Develop practical policy options with analysts
role.ambitious_version: Use measured proposal drafting gains to strengthen the research case while protecting student and client advice.
